title: Card Payment History Rate in the Home Delivery Pharmacy Settlement Courtesy
content:
## Billing desk guidance: card history at settlement

**Rule.** For a Home Delivery Pharmacy member who settles the past-due amount in full, a settlement courtesy reduction is given at the sum of its courtesy rates, one of which is a card-history rate: 2 percent when a credit, debit or HSA/FSA card is on file and three or more payments by such cards are dated less than 12 whole months before the handling date, 1 percent when a card is on file and one or two such payments are, and nothing otherwise. The courtesy rates are added together and applied once to the past-due amount, and only that result is rounded to the nearest cent.

"On file" is the payment method recorded on the home delivery account; the payments counted are member payments made by credit card, debit card or HSA/FSA card.

### Rate table

| Card on file | Card payments dated less than 12 whole months before the handling date | Card-history rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 3 or more | 2 percent |
| Yes | 1 or 2 | 1 percent |
| Yes | none | nothing |
| No | any | nothing |

### Hypothetical cases

- Credit card on file, four card payments in the year: 2 percent.
- Debit card on file, two payments by debit card and one by check: two card payments, 1 percent.
